Name: Chocobo Valley Remixed (Unofficial)
Author: Ex0dus
Description:
[size=4][b]Description:[/b][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Chocobo Valley Remixed is a reworking of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22226]Chocobo Valley[/url] mod by Kitsutsune. It adds multiple uses for all of the items in that mod as well as adding lots of additional content to go with it! Chocobos now also have a progression between species with higher tiers of Chocobos providing higher value items.[/size][/color]


[size=4][b]Main features:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Chocobo Progression: Instead of being able to get any large breed of Chocobo once you have an Ostrich Incubator, you must now pay Buckwheat a rare egg of the Chocobo tier below to get a common egg of a higher tier Chocobo. At the beginning you will only have access to the Ferngill Mini and Jylland Dwarf Chocobos. Each has its own progression path to follow with different breeds. To see the progression paths, click on the spoiler below:[/size][/color][/*]
[/list][spoiler][size=3]Path 1: Ferngill Mini -->  Lucian Palfrey --> Vana'delian Courser --> Ivalician Draft

Path 2: Jylland Dwarf --> Eorzean Destrier --> Pulsian Steppe -->  Ivalician Draft[/size][/spoiler]

[list]
[*][size=3]Every Chocobo Valley item has been given multiple uses. Some items are used in newly added recipes, others in one of two new buildable merchant shops, others have had context tags added to them to allow them to be used in[/size][size=3] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46186]Appleseed's Lathe[/url] mod. [/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Eorzean and Pulsian Chocobos have been reworked. Eorzean Chocobos now drop decorative dolls (which can also be sold) featuring creatures found in Final Fantasy games. Pulsian Chocobos now dig up ores, essences, new flower seeds and valuable bones (which can also be used in Appleseed's Lathe mod).[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Chocobo Egg and Mayo Rework: Since Chocobos have defined tiers now, prices on higher tiered eggs have been increased accordingly. This can be especially useful when using the eggs in Appleseed's Lathe. To make Chocobo mayo a bit different than all of the dozens of other mayo items out there, Chocobo mayo now inherits the quality of the egg used to make it. Prices and recovery of the mayo items have been adjusted accordingly to hopefully not make them busted, but overall Chocobo mayo is now much more useful than it used to be.[/size][/*]
[/list][list]
[*][size=3]Bugfixes*: Several minor bugs from Chocobo Valley have been fixed, mostly relating to Perfection. [/size][/*]
[/list][list]
[*][size=3]Gift Tastes: Gift taste data has been added for both Chocobo Valley* and Chocobo Valley Remixed items. Currently gift tastes have been added for all Base Game, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp [/url]characters.[/size][/*]
[/list][size=3]*Bugfixes and Gift Tastes for original Chocobo Valley items will be removed from this mod once Kitsutsune adds them to Chocobo Valley. [/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements:[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22226]Chocobo Valley[/url][/size][/*]
[*][size=3](Optional)  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46186]Appleseed's Lathe[/url]- For additional uses for Egg, Feather and Bone items[/size][/*]
[/list]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=4][b]Installation instructions:[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
[size=3]Standard mod installation instructions apply; be sure you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22226]Chocobo Valley[/url] and its requirements installed first, otherwise this mod will do nothing.[/size][/color]
